items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: Sonny Schuyler, he was nice to work with. He introduced It's Later Than You Think, all of those kind of things.

ctx.x: Ten years. I know you were there in 66 because Pushera told me about it. Then, you know, I just... Yeah. Happened to have that on tape. This is Capital Records.

Right. Sonny Schuyler. Oh, yeah. And Schuyler. Sonny Schuyler wrote some fine tunes. Mm-hmm. Enjoy yourself. It's later than you think. This is one of the most unique things that I... This was down in Puerto Barrios in Guatemala.
